evidence: This captivating performance has been the heart and soul of the theatre since its inaugural night in 1969, echoing the grandeur of the ancient capital Thăng Long, named by King Lý Thái Tổ when he relocated the imperial seat in the early 11th century. The term "Teu" in the Nôm script signifies laughter, personifying a playful narrator who bridges the gap between the stage and the real world.
